column1: # Mogall keeper: the door to the camp.

column3: Open the door to the camp?{end_now}
Open it. They're not\nmonsters, they're just\nfrightened.{end_wait}
Then you'll be the one who\nburies whatever comes out.\nI buried the others.{end_wait}
One of them is humming a\nlullaby, Isaac. She just\nwon't stop.{end_wait}
I'm sorry, but we can't\nsave all of them.{end_wait}
At least that was honest.\nNow keep walking, Isaac.{end_wait}
